detail: Full summary: Append cost root cause: append() → validateOptions() → admittedView() read every admitted event file and ran the whole reducer on every write (O(n) per append, O(n²) per corpus). Memoized on COUNT+MAX(id) over admitted rows with explicit invalidation where admitted bytes change (purge, signature swap, rebuild). Measured: 16k p50 28.5→9.9 ms, p95 50.8→31.6 ms; last-decile p95 flat (10.7–10.9 ms) at both 8k and 16k; residual ~10 ms is ed25519 signing + two fsyncs. Lane 05's 35k threshold should be re-measured, not assumed gone.
